text:
morgan (People Ops): leaving this thread for any follow-ups from today's all-hands re: summer hybrid changes, hub etiquette, and offsite logistics 97 ask short Qs and we'll reply here. :sun_with_face:
kai (Eng): quick Q: is the new summer offsite cap per-person or per-invoice? planning a 20p event.
sam (Finance): cap is per-person for food+venue. Travel & taxes billed separately. We'll publish a sample budget template.
adele (PM): for hybrid offsites, do we reimburse remote folks for coworking to join sessions?
morgan (People Ops): yes: remote attendees can claim a daily coworking stipend for days they join the offsite sessions remotely, up to 3 days per event. Claim via expense with a short note.
li (Contractor): badge access: I was denied at Hub-North last week. Do contractors still need pre-approval each week?
olga (Talent): contractors with recurring onsite work (>10 days in 30) should get badge auto-provision. Otherwise submit day-pass requests to ops@redwood at least 24h ahead. For urgent same-day access DM @people-ops.
kai (Eng): visa letter lead time? candidate interviewing from EU needs a letter next week.
morgan (People Ops): standard turnaround 3 business days after request + manager approval. Mark subject "visa - expedite" for faster handling.
ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/policies/hybrid-and-travel (policy snapshot)
adele (PM): accessibility question: are evening social events required to have non-alcoholic and low-sensory options?
morgan (People Ops): yes. Add that to vendor brief: at least 2 non-alcoholic drink options and one low-sensory activity. We'll attach a checklist template to the policy.
sam (Finance): reimbursement reminder: submit receipts within 30 days or they'll be auto-rejected. Use Concur for travel bookings.
kai (Eng): last one: parking blocks for interview days 97 can teams reserve a block?
morgan (People Ops): yes, teams can request temporary blocks; fill the short form in the intranet doc. Ops reviews within 48h.
morgan (People Ops): thanks all 97 we'll post a concise follow-up in #announcements and update the policy doc. If you need exceptions DM me or tag @people-ops. :white_check_mark:
